hints.title: Symmetric Pairs
hints.text: Generate symmetric pairs of opposite numbers like i and -i. Their sum is always zero.

hints.title: Handle Odd Length
hints.text: If n is odd, include 0 in the result. For each pair up to n // 2, append i and -i.

hints.title: Direct Construction
hints.text: For i from 1 to n // 2, append i and -i. If n % 2 == 1, append 0.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Arbitrary random selection requires solving a subset sum or equation balancing.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Deterministic symmetric pair construction directly produces exact sum zero in linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate spots the algebraic symmetry (i, -i) and handles odd parity with 0.
complexity.notes: Unique numbers guaranteed since i ranges from 1 to floor(n / 2).
